history.intent: INT-16 Buy 2 get 1 free on paperbacks
history.intentBody: In subtotal(), for paperback lines every third copy is free (qty 3 → pay for 2, qty 6 → pay for 4). It does not stack with the bulk discount: apply whichever gives the lower line price. Add tests.
history.summary: Every third paperback is free; does not stack with the bulk discount (cheaper rule wins).
decisions: Bulk discount and buy-2-get-1 do not stack: each line pays the cheaper of the two.

history.intent: INT-5 Bulk discount: 10% off 3+ copies of the same book
history.intentBody: In subtotal(), a line with qty >= 3 gets 10% off that line (rounded to the nearest cent). Add tests.
decisions: Bulk discount rounds per line with Math.round so totals stay in whole cents.
